text: And Jonah prayed to YHWH his God from the bowels of the fish,
and he said: “I called out from the distress of mine to YHWH, and He answered me; from the belly of Sheol I cried out—You heard my voice.
And You cast me [into] the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current surrounded me; all Your billows and Your waves passed over me.
And I said, ‘I have been driven out from before Your eyes; yet I will add to look toward the temple of Your holiness.’
The waters surrounded me up to the soul, the deep closed around me, the seaweed wrapped around my head.
To the bases of the mountains I went down; the earth with her bars [was] behind me forever. And You brought up my life from the pit, O YHWH my God.
At the fainting within me of my soul, I remembered YHWH; my prayer came in to You, to the temple of Your holiness.
Those guarding vanities of worthlessness leave behind their loving devotion.
And I, with a voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You; what I have vowed, I will fulfill. Salvation [is] of YHWH.”
And YHWH spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto the dry land.
